# *spatialist* - Spatialise your images!

## Overview

The *spatialist* package provides functionality to read image files and
produce plots that simulate spatial omics data (e.g., 10x Genomics
Visium and Xenium).

## Example

| Xenium-like | Visium-like |
|:--:|:--:|
| ![Xenium-like output.](https://kevinrue.github.io/spatialist/articles/spatialist_files/figure-html/spatial-1.png) | ![Visium-like output.](https://kevinrue.github.io/spatialist/articles/spatialist_files/figure-html/visium-1.png) |

## Installation

*spatialist* can be easily installed from GitHub using
[`remotes::install_github()`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/reference/install_github.html):

``` r

install.packages(c("remotes", "BiocManager"))
options(repos = BiocManager::repositories())
remotes::install_github("kevinrue/spatialist", dependencies = TRUE)
```

## Functionalities

Spatialise images

  : Title

  : Convert Image to Matrix
- [`make_heatmap()`](https://kevinrue.github.io/spatialist/reference/make_heatmap.md)
  : Display Heatmap of Binary Matrix
- [`make_jitter()`](https://kevinrue.github.io/spatialist/reference/make_jitter.md)
  : Jitterplot
- [`make_point()`](https://kevinrue.github.io/spatialist/reference/make_point.md)
  : Scatterplot
- [`make_spatial()`](https://kevinrue.github.io/spatialist/reference/make_spatial.md)
  : Spatial Plot
- [`spatialise()`](https://kevinrue.github.io/spatialist/reference/spatialise.md)
  : Spatialise Images
